headline: Stlican Shelf Narrows as Fisherman's Row Tilts Toward Wardens
war_summary: Since our last edition, Fisherman's Row has tilted further toward the Wardens, who now count seven of nine posts against two Colonial, with exchanges still brisk about Eidolo, Dankana Post and Black Well. On the Stlican Shelf the Colonial margin has narrowed to five-four, Breaker Town alone accounting for thirty-four base events in a day. Callahan's Passage, nine posts Warden and one in ruins, remains the costliest file of all: casualties in the latest hour run past seventeen hundred Colonial and two thousand Warden, with fresh movements logged at The Crumbling Passage right to press time. The Weathered Expanse holds its five-four Colonial line under steady hammering, Warden losses near eighteen hundred an hour against twelve hundred fifty Colonial around Wightwalk and Frostmarch. The Nevish Line has flared anew, its seven-one Warden front drawing heavy toll from both sides, while Colonial-held ground in the Linn of Mercy absorbs close to nine hundred Warden casualties an hour. Mooring County's guns, loud at our last filing, have since fallen quiet. It is day 413 of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
